_notice: DEMO DATA for the Royal Hallamshire scenario. Route numbers, gradients, roadworks, events and toilets are illustrative and must be checked against Travel South Yorkshire, Sheffield City Council (Street Manager), Environment Agency LIDAR and AccessAble before any real use. Entrance names come from the Sheffield Teaching Hospitals accessibility list.

entrances.name: A Floor Outpatients Entrance (entrance 2)
entrances.notes: Listed by the Trust as wheelchair accessible. Confirm lift and drop-off details on AccessAble.

entrances.name: B Floor Main Entrance (entrance 9)
entrances.notes: Listed by the Trust as wheelchair accessible. Main reception and lifts.

entrances.notes: Listed by the Trust as wheelchair accessible.

options.title: Bus 95: South Road to Glossop Road

legs.instruction: Roll 45 m along level pavement on South Road to the South Rd / Fir St stop.
Bus 95 towards the city centre. Ask the driver for the ramp. Alight at Glossop Rd / Beech Hill Rd.
Roll 50 m down Beech Hill Road to the A Floor Outpatients Entrance.

Supertram Blue or Yellow towards the city. Alight at University of Sheffield.
Roll 650 m along Western Bank and Glossop Road to the hospital.

options.title: Wheelchair-accessible taxi, door to door
